name: ${mod_name}
description: Extra cosmetic forms for Cobblemon. Backrooms (Still Life copies, Yellow Carpet), Thanksgiving (harvest colours, Pumpkin Pie) Halloween (animated gore and body horror, Carved Pumpkin), Christmas (Santa Snorlax, tree Turtwig, gift Trubbish, Krampus Phantump and twinkling lights, Snowball), Easter (egg Togepi, Easter Bunny Lopunny and pastels, Egg), Five Nights at Freddy's (Freddy Teddiursa, Chica Torchic, Foxy Sandile and animatronics, Clock), Ice Sculpture (any ice block), Stone Statue (stone, smooth stone or chiseled stone bricks) Naruto (Kurama Ninetales, Sasuke Xurkitree, shinobi; flint) and Trans Pride (the flag's stripes head to toe; light blue, pink or white banner) forms for 180 whole evolutionary lines. Put the item in a supported Pokémon's cosmetic slot. Also adds Iron Boulder (#1022) and Celesteela (#797) as roaming legendaries, and, with Mega Showdown, Mega Evolutions for Great Tusk, Scream Tail, Brute Bonnet, Flutter Mane and Slither Wing with craftable mega stones.
